sonnet.problem: The opening card says David is 'the youngest son of Jesse of Bethlehem'. That gives away the answer ('Jesse') to the fill-in-the-blank on card 8, which asks 'a son of ___ of Bethlehem'.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The story card repeats the donkey, bread, wine-skin and young goat that card 12 just asked about and answered. It is a recap and adds nothing new except David entering service, which the next cards cover.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The last story card re-tells the answer to card 19 (Saul finds relief, feels better, the spirit of distress departs). The passage's last verse was already asked on a choice card, so the final card should be just the 'story isn't over' line.
sonnet.rule: When the passage's last verse is asked on a choice card, the last story card can be just this line.
